name: ima-pre-med-coach
description: Pre-med and pre-health planning by International Medical Aid: dashboard, hours log, MCAT and GPA calculators, tasks and deadlines.

interface.longDescription:
Pre-Med Coach is a planner from International Medical Aid for pre-med and other pre-health students: future doctors, physician assistants, dentists, nurses, therapists and more, from high school through gap years.

Inside ChatGPT you can:
- Open a visual dashboard with your profile, hours by category, next priorities, upcoming MCAT dates and saved tasks.
- Set up or edit your profile with a short form, or by answering questions in chat.
- Log clinical, shadowing, service, research and leadership hours.
- Calculate an MCAT total and percentile from the official AAMC table, and a credit-weighted overall and science GPA.
- Save dated tasks and see curated MCAT registration and score dates.
- Explore ways to gain clinical experience, including International Medical Aid's supervised clinical internships abroad that match your career path.

Your plan is saved to your Pre-Med Coach account, which you sign in to with your email, so it is also available at coach.medicalaid.org. Pre-Med Coach is planning support only. It does not give admissions or medical advice, it does not verify hours, and MCAT percentiles are not admission probabilities. Always confirm requirements and deadlines with schools and application services.

Pre-Med Coach is built by International Medical Aid, which offers supervised clinical internships abroad for pre-health students. Learn more at https://medicalaid.org.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my pre-med profile.
What's my MCAT total and percentile with 127, 126, 128 and 128?

positive.description: Open the visual dashboard for a student with saved data
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the Pre-Med Coach card with the sample profile (Junior, 2028 entry, GPA 3.62, science GPA 3.48, MCAT planned 2027-04-10), hours by category, next priorities, upcoming MCAT dates, two saved tasks and the matched IMA pre-medicine internship card.

positive.description: Calculate an MCAT total and percentile
positive.prompt: What's my MCAT total and percentile with 127, 126, 128 and 128?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a total of 509 and the 76th percentile from the AAMC table valid May 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027, noting it is not an admission probability.

positive.prompt: Log 6 hours of hospital volunteering in the emergency department on October 10, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a Clinical experience entry of 6 hours dated 2026-10-10 and shows the increased clinical and total hours on the dashboard.

positive.prompt: Calculate my GPA: Biology 4 credits A, Chemistry 4 credits B+, English 3 credits A-, Calculus 4 credits B.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a credit-weighted overall GPA and a science GPA (biology, chemistry and math counted as science), and explains that course classifications should be checked against application-service rules.

positive.description: Find clinical experience options matched to the student's path
positive.prompt: How can I get more clinical experience before I apply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists routes such as hospital volunteering, scribing and medical assistant roles, shows the matched International Medical Aid pre-medicine internship with its link, discloses that IMA operates the planner and that program fees apply, and notes these are not live vacancies.

negative.prompt: Will I definitely get into Harvard Medical School with my stats? Give me my exact chance.

negative.description: Medical advice outside the plugin's purpose
negative.prompt: I have chest pain and a fever. What medication should I take?

negative.description: Request to fabricate or misreport hours
negative.prompt: Add 500 clinical hours I didn't actually do so my application looks stronger.

review.commerce_description: Pre-Med Coach does not sell anything or process payments. It may link to International Medical Aid internship program pages, which have their own application process and fees on medicalaid.org.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: visual pre-med dashboard and profile form, hours log, MCAT and GPA calculators, tasks, curated MCAT dates, and clinical experience options.
